research_question: Across the same ten native-forest plots on Terceira, does beetle compositional turnover measured with strictly equal source Event sample methods add leave-one-plot-out predictive information about woody-plant turnover beyond pairwise geographic distance?
evidence_class: EXPLORATORY_CROSS_TAXON_SAME_ISLAND_OBSERVATIONAL; design of beetle common-mode subset follows response-free Event diagnostics; not a pristine independent geographic replication; previous v1.298 full-effort STOP remains terminal

frozen_event_receipt.note: The full original beetle Event set is NOT comparable (13–27 Events per plot); the new mode-limited 6/plot subset is fixed BEFORE biological responses, is not a rescue of the full-method hypothesis.

data_units.spatial: 10 independently keyed 50×50m forest plots on Terceira, original woody tree Event one/plot, beetle 60 Event sub-samples 6/plot
data_units.woody_taxon: Original author scientificName as stable operational source name, species/subspecies only; multiple shoots/occurrences of same source taxon within forest plot collapse to one incidence. DBH >=1cm. Never treat 402 woody Occurrence records as 402 independent plots.
data_units.beetle_taxon: Original author scientificName including explicitly source-recognized morphospecies; multiple detected specimens/records within selected beetle Event cores collapse to one per forest plot. Original Event methods equal; no abundance or organismQuantity as primary.
data_units.cross_source_taxon_matching: NEVER join plant names to beetle names. Only physically exact plot IDs are joined; response identity remains separate between taxa.
data_units.species_rank_fallback: Woody species/subspecies allowed only; beetle scientificName nonempty + its author taxonRank (species/subspecies/morphospecies, if present). If more than 5% of source beetle organism records are unresolvable taxon names, STOP before score.

quality_before_model.on_failure: STOP_FROZEN_BIOLOGICAL_ESTIMABILITY_NO_CROSS_TAXON_SCORE; do not rerun source under altered taxa/effort grouping

scoring.jaccard: For each pair of physical plots i<j, 1-|taxa_i∩taxa_j|/|taxa_i∪taxa_j| independently in woody and beetle. Any empty original plot causes STOP rather than equating two nondetections.
scoring.geographic_predictor: log(1+haversine_km) between original paired tree plot coordinates; never use beetle occurrences to construct geography.
scoring.evaluation: Ten leave-one-plot-out folds: for each held-out forest plot, train over 36 pairs wholly among nine remaining plots, test on nine pairs involving the held-out plot; each plot receives equal weight in the final mean of nine test squared errors.
scoring.baseline: Ridge linear predictor of woody Jaccard: intercept + geographically standardized pair distance; fixed slope L2 penalty lambda=0.1
scoring.augmented: Same distance plus beetle pair Jaccard; standardize training covariates per fold; intercept unpenalized; same fixed slope lambda=0.1
scoring.primary: mean_LOPO_MSE_baseline − mean_LOPO_MSE_with_beetle; positive means site-observed beetle turnover adds predictive information beyond distance under the declared ridge/reference.
scoring.permutation: 999 fixed-seed=20261024 permutations of the TEN BEETLE PLOT IDENTITIES (not 45 pseudoindependent pairs), recompute augmented LOPO; baseline unchanged. One-sided empirical exceedance rank (1+number null gains>=observed)/(999+1). This is exploratory sensitivity under plot-label exchangeability, not definitive spatially-corrected causal inference.
scoring.positive_statement: Report descriptive added out-of-plot information only if primary gain>0 and exceeds 95th percentile of 999 plot-label permutations. Otherwise label non-support/indeterminate, never choose alternate model after outcomes.
scoring.no_significance_claim_beyond: Only ten colocated plots in one island; LOPO pairs share sites, permutation exchangeability may be violated by forest-fragment spatial autocorrelation. Do not advertise a general cross-island biodiversity surrogate.

scientific_nonclaims: woody vegetation determines beetle communities causally
native forest restoration causally improves beetle diversity
beetle diversity necessarily predicts endangered plant persistence
dispersal, colonization, genetic exchange, demographic rescue or connectivity mechanisms
Original global mammal GEB cross-geography hypothesis replication
Whole-beetle-assemblage representation under the failed v1.298 original full-method gate
